candidate_if_signal_passes.base_error_prediction: current correction-independent T0 branch detached before transition aggregation
candidate_if_signal_passes.initial_identity: same seed, parameters, RNG state, time state, quantity state, and outputs equal T0 before the new path is trained
candidate_if_signal_passes.quantity_route: T0 fused state plus scalar causal transition read times a learned hidden direction
candidate_if_signal_passes.shared_structure: one identical graph and training rule across all datasets with no dataset ID branch
candidate_if_signal_passes.time_route: unchanged T0 h plus static Hard-LMM residual

local_checkpoint_override.reason: canonical registry checkpoint file is absent locally; this audited e300 checkpoint has the exact registry-pinned model_state_sha256

deferred_follow_up.name: quantile-adaptive loss and checkpoint alignment
deferred_follow_up.priority_condition: after the Backbone candidate is resolved, use this when common raw performance across the three datasets is the higher priority

diagnostic_scope.window_semantics: all token predictions and retrieval traces come from the same legal target window used for the final prediction

performance_evaluation_if_implemented.e1_interpretation: execution and contract compliance only; never a performance decision

historical_strong_effect_criterion.meaning: reported separately from the common raw-RMSE goal; it is not silently weakened

seed42_common_screen.body_guardrail: body MAE regression versus paired T0 no greater than 2 percent on every dataset
seed42_common_screen.common_raw_goal: raw quantity RMSE strictly improves versus paired T0 on all three datasets
seed42_common_screen.continuation: run seeds 52 and 62 only when every condition passes
seed42_common_screen.tail_guardrail: greater-than-train-p99 MAE regression versus paired T0 no greater than 2 percent on every dataset
seed42_common_screen.time_guardrail: time NLL increase versus paired T0 no greater than 0.01 on every dataset

performance_evaluation_if_implemented.three_seed_decision: paired-seed aggregate versus T0, with RMTPP and THP superiority assessed separately

probe.correction: a_corrected = a_base + intercept + standardized_features times coefficients
probe.folding: two series-disjoint out-of-fold fits; fit and standardization use the opposite fold only
probe.l2_penalty_interpretation: standard Ridge alpha=1 on summed squared error; intercept unpenalized
probe.objective: summed squared error between softplus(a_corrected) and log1p(target_quantity), plus L2 penalty

research_question: Does a causal prototype-conditioned summary of already observed T0 quantity errors provide common next-quantity signal across Intermittent, Taxi, and Instacart?

signal_gate.body_requirement: prototype candidate must not worsen pooled or either-fold body MAE versus T0, strong control, or sham
signal_gate.common_requirement: both comparisons and all guardrails pass for all three datasets

paired_series_bootstrap.interpretation: fixed-prediction stability interval, not a formal refitted-probe significance test

signal_gate.pass_interpretation: necessary train-internal signal for implementation, not validation performance or model adoption

transition_feature.causal_prefix: state i may read only transitions with observed endpoint t <= i
transition_feature.gradient: base logits, errors, and discrete prototype assignment are detached from the candidate correction path
transition_feature.prototype_value: per-prototype arithmetic mean of assigned observed errors
transition_feature.read: arithmetic mean of the current state's four prototype values; unseen prototypes contribute zero
transition_feature.sham: within each legal window cyclically permute only the past write assignments while retaining the actual current read indices
transition_feature.target_exclusion: the final target quantity, its error, padding, and non-write positions never enter the summary
transition_feature.valid_transition: both endpoints are observed and memory-write-eligible
transition_feature.write_assignment: e_t is assigned uniformly to each of the previous state's four T0 prototype indices
